qualifications: Terra c58 low-power delta 6.5 dB is approximate arithmetic from rounded inputs; unrounded delta is 6.436823542285343 dB. Direction and qualitative comparison pass.
Returning-material rubric describes acoustic similarity, not source or phrase identity. In c58 the return is enriched low/high B, not low-pulse-only A.
Luna source PCM wording is imprecise: samples exist and all values are zero, rather than an empty interval.
Small tests and partial judgments do not yield a general musical-understanding accuracy percentage.
